explication: Oh Story is a file-system-based web-fiction writing skill package for coding agents. Its principal workflow moves from platform ranking research to long- or short-form analysis, then outlining and drafting, deterministic prose checks, and continuity/tracking updates. Separate capabilities include importing existing manuscripts, agent setup and hooks, a local dashboard, and cover generation. The README documents the product stages; sampled scripts and the source index clarify selected scraper, analysis, lint, and hook internals. Several capabilities are represented at their skill-directory level because their implementation was not sampled.
